title: Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Video Generation for Autonomous Driving
control_family: layout, box, map or BEV conditioning

output_modality.value: multi-view (6 views, panoramic) video, 8 frames at 256x512

control_signal.value: BEV layout sequences (projected 3D boxes, object depths, road maps, camera poses), text for weather, time and scene, and an optional conditioning image

control_mechanism.value: BEV sequences via ControlNet; text via frozen CLIP encoder; conditioning image concatenated with diffused input in a two-stage pipeline

base_model.value: Stable Diffusion 2.1 UNet with decomposed 4D attention (intra-view, cross-view, cross-frame); two-stage image then video training

datasets.value: nuScenes (700 train, 150 val, 150 test scenes, 6 cameras); StreamPETR trained for downstream evaluation; synthesised Gen-nuScenes set of 139440 videos

metrics.value: FID, FVD, View-Matching-Score for consistency; controllability via StreamPETR NDS, mAP, mAOE, mAVE on generated data

controllability_evidence.value: Perception NDS on generated val data 32.1 versus 46.9 on real, 68% relative; real plus generated training reaches NDS 49.2 (+2.3). ControlNet beats concatenation: FVD 139 versus 226.

closed_loop.value: No: open-loop generation from BEV sequences. Long videos made by sliding window with layout control dropped, shown qualitatively only.

stated_limitations.value: Temporal and view consistency imperfect for long frame lengths; high inference cost; relatively low spatial resolution; model design not refined further because of time and resources.

notes: Table 1 reports FVD 139 and FID 16.96 on nuScenes val.
